source_checked: https://arxiv.org/html/2511.21689 (full text incl. appendices A, L and Tables 1, 2, 3, 15, 16)
sampling: prose paragraphs numbered 1-20 after front matter (headings, images, tables, display equations not counted); took paragraphs 3,6,9,12,15,18, wrapped to 1,4,7,10,13,16,19 (13 includes the results table it introduces); 15 claims drawn from these

A: Headings are topic names (L19 '## 연구 배경', L29 '## 제안 방법', L47 '## 구현 방식'); acceptable for the fixed five-section summary.
L42 uses 'max(1, ...)' instead of '\max' and wraps a superscript in {% raw %} Liquid; renders but is awkward. Front matter complete, description 128 chars, math only $$.
B: L70 'FRAMES' vs L80 'Frames' -- inconsistent benchmark name.
L82 '비교 모델 가운데서는 여전히 1위지만, 적어도 τ²-Bench에서는 미학습 도구 구성일 때 점수가 기본 구성보다 낮아집니다.' restates the previous sentence; drop it.
L27 '프롬프트 기반 오케스트레이터는 이런 판단 대신 습관적인 선택을 반복합니다' -- '습관적' is the writer's gloss, not the paper's framing; rewrite: '프롬프트 기반 오케스트레이터는 비용을 따지지 않고 같은 모델을 반복해서 고릅니다.'
L31 '연구 배경에서 본 호출 쏠림 때문에 보상 설계가 학습의 핵심입니다' -- causal leap; rewrite: '호출 쏠림을 막으려고 보상에 비용과 선호를 함께 넣었습니다.'
C: L27 ends the background with the trained Orchestrator-8B's balanced calls, which L78 states again as the significance -- same fact twice.
L40 is a one-sentence paragraph bridging to the eval formula; L82 sentence 2-3 repeat each other.
D: Reward sign intuition (L38 '비용과 지연 항은 음수이므로 ... 정규화 값이 커집니다') and the labelled worked ratio (L45 '30/10=3') help at the right moment.
Training algorithm (GRPO, group-normalized advantage, clipped objective; paper §3.2) is never named, so 'RL로 학습' stays a black box.
E: The headline HLE/FRAMES comparison (Table 1) is only in prose (L70); a second short table or HLE/FRAMES columns would help. TL;DR (L17) numbers lack units (비용 10.3, 지연 8.6).
F: No wrong number in the 15-claim sample.

Outside the sample, L82 'τ²-Bench 점수는 기본 도구 구성에서 낸 점수보다 크게 낮습니다': the 80.2 comes from the basic tools + specialized + generalist LLMs configuration, not the 'basic tools' setting the post's own table (L64) names '기본 도구' -- setting mis-attributed (-2). The run's own verifier warning flagged the same sentence.

L53 '영화 예매 도메인이라면 예약 테이블과 취소·환불 도구가 먼저 생기고' and L27 '매 턴 웹 검색, 코드 실행기, GPT-5-mini, GPT-5 중 하나' are writer illustrations not marked as such at first use (L78 later calls the HLE one '가상의'); the paper's pilot tool set was GPT-5, GPT-5-mini, Qwen3-32B, Qwen2.5-Coder-32B (Appendix A).
U1: All five questions covered; implementation omits GRPO, the base model being Qwen3-8B (only implied at L40), and the dataset name ToolScale appears only in an image alt text (L51).
U2: TL;DR (L17) is five sentences with six numbers, longer than the two-to-three-line target.
The one stated limitation (L82) is the writer's, and rests on the mis-labelled comparison above; the closing paragraph is long relative to the summary.

claim_headings.evidence: L19/L29/L47/L57/L76 are fixed topic headings (연구 배경, 제안 방법, 구현 방식, 실험 결과, 의의와 한계).

facts_said_once.evidence: Orchestrator-8B's balanced calls stated L27 and L78; L82 sentences 2-3 repeat.

numbers_with_scope_unit.evidence: Table L61 gives units (미국 센트, 분) and settings; TL;DR L17 and L80 '비용 34.8과 지연 8.2' lack units; L82 mislabels the setting of 80.2.

nothing_invented.evidence: No invented numbers; L82 setting mislabel; L53 movie cancel/refund tools unlabelled illustration.

writer_assessment_at_end.evidence: L82 '이 글은 ... 봅니다' is the writer's view, but ends by re-telling the paper's future work ('재귀적 오케스트레이터 시스템').
